title: binary_search off-by-one on upper bound
description: binary_search should return the index of target or -1. The bug initializes the high bound to len(arr) instead of len(arr) - 1 and keeps the inclusive 'lo <= hi' loop, so it reads one past the end for some inputs (IndexError) and mishandles the top element.

hidden_tests.test_bsearch.py:
from bsearch import binary_search


def test_binary_search():
    arr = [1, 3, 5, 7, 9, 11]
    assert binary_search(arr, 1) == 0
    assert binary_search(arr, 11) == 5
    assert binary_search(arr, 7) == 3
    assert binary_search(arr, 4) == -1
    assert binary_search([], 1) == -1
    assert binary_search([2], 2) == 0
    assert binary_search([2], 5) == -1
